name: document-region-attach-refused
description: The host refuses a restored interactionState, and the region then attaches again without it; a later attach of a region that fails is the error of that attach, and the state read of the attached region answers its state.
reason: The attach creates a document region of a window, which only the native host with a window produces (docs/spec/cases/page-wire/README.md#producer-runs).

reply.error: interactionState is not a session history
